title: onopordum acanthium subsp. horridum
intro: Onopordum acanthium subsp. horridum, commonly known as the Scotch thistle, is a subspecies of the Onopordum acanthium plant, a thistle native to Europe and western Asia. It is a flowering plant known for its prickly stems and purple flowers, which are rich in bioactive constituents. The health benefits of Onopordum acanthium subsp. horridum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
